title: NovaTrade IRB — Order Intent Contract
description: Internal schema for the governed order intents created by the Trading Agent from validated IRB alert payloads. This is the intermediate representation between alert ingestion and broker execution.

intent_type.description: The governed action to perform. Derived from alert action: PLACE_STOP_ORDER->PLACE_ORDER, REPLACE_STOP_ORDER->REPLACE_ORDER, MODIFY_SL->MODIFY_SL, CANCEL_ORDER->CANCEL_ORDER, CLOSE_POSITION->CLOSE_POSITION

idempotency_key.description: Deterministic key: irb_{action}_{bar_close_time}_{side}. Prevents duplicate submission of the same alert.

broker_symbol.description: Broker-resolved symbol (e.g. EURUSD.sim). Resolved via FtmoProfile.resolve_symbol() from the display symbol.

side.description: Trade direction. Passed through from alert payload.

strategy_version.description: Strategy version. Must match strategy_spec.yaml v2.0.0.

campaign.description: Campaign label for evidence tagging (e.g. ftmo-free-trial-march-2026).

source_bar_time.description: Unix ms timestamp of the source bar that triggered the alert. 0 if not available.

created_at.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) when the intent was created by the Trading Agent.

order_type.description: Order type. Always STOP for IRB (BUY_STOP or SELL_STOP, determined by side). Only present for PLACE_ORDER/REPLACE_ORDER intents.

entry_price.description: Stop order trigger price: IRB extreme +/- 1 pip. Only present for PLACE_ORDER/REPLACE_ORDER.

stop_loss.description: Stop loss price: IRB opposite side +/- 1 pip. Authoritative — passed directly to broker. Only present for PLACE_ORDER/REPLACE_ORDER.

volume.description: Lot size from Pine risk-based sizing, clamped [0.01, 1.00]. Only present for PLACE_ORDER/REPLACE_ORDER.

new_stop_loss.description: New trailing stop level. Only present for MODIFY_SL intents. Authoritative.

old_stop_loss.description: Previous stop loss level (informational). Only present for MODIFY_SL intents.

cancel_reason.description: Reason for cancellation. Only present for CANCEL_ORDER intents.

close_reason.description: Reason for position close. Only present for CLOSE_POSITION intents.

_implementation_notes.idempotency: Keys are generated deterministically from alert fields. A bounded set (max 1000) is maintained in memory. Duplicate keys are rejected immediately.
_implementation_notes.symbol_resolution: broker_symbol is resolved from display symbol via FtmoProfile.resolve_symbol(). Alert-provided broker_symbol is validated against resolution — mismatches are logged but resolved value takes precedence.
_implementation_notes.risk_gate: PLACE_ORDER and REPLACE_ORDER intents pass through RiskEngine.pre_trade_check() before execution. MODIFY_SL, CANCEL_ORDER, and CLOSE_POSITION bypass risk checks (they reduce or close exposure).
_implementation_notes.evidence: Every intent is recorded to the append-only JSONL evidence trail regardless of outcome.
